documentation.content: The public judge experience is returning sustained server errors. Follow the checked-in runbook: https://github.com/gowtham0992/Nightwatch/blob/main/cloud/monitoring/runbook.md

conditions.displayName: Public service 5xx rate exceeds 0.01 requests per second for two minutes

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_revision" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND metric.label.response_code_class = "5xx" AND resource.label.service_name = "nightwatch-public"
